items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: So she told me Billie Holiday used to come up there and listen to her.

ctx.x: Utterly amazing. Brought me, literally, to tears.

You see, up on 52nd Street I missed her because I was over on the other side of the street. She was up at Tony's and I wasn't aware of Tony's. I was young and I listened to all the saxophone players, you know, on this end. Tatum and everybody. If I'd have just had the presence of mind or if somebody would have said something to me, I could have walked up the street in 1946 and heard her then. So she told me Billie Holiday used to come up there and listen to her. I know that Billie got a lot of stuff from her,…
had to come up and get mad (at Billie) and tell her to come back and do her job. Hahahaha. Yeah.
